$comment: The rules where a wrong answer harms a person (docs/testing.md § Critical rules), each with the tests that hold it. tooling/critical-rules.mjs checks that every test named here exists. A test marked `caught` once caught a real bug: it may leave only through `retired`, with the reason.

rules.rule: The server's roster moves only by the commit that wins its epoch.

tests.name: sets the roster to the claim of the commit that wins its epoch
stores one commit per epoch, and older application messages too
a_claim_that_leaves_a_member_out_is_corrected

rules.rule: A commit whose claim leaves out its sender or does not match its Welcome is refused.

tests.name: refuses a commit whose claim leaves out its sender or does not match its Welcome
a_claim_the_commit_does_not_back_is_seen_and_corrected

rules.rule: An account a commit removes cannot read past that commit, nor fetch earlier media.

tests.name: lets an account a commit left out read up to that commit
stops a removed member fetching what was sent before
a_revoked_device_cannot_read_after_its_removal

rules.rule: Groups use the ciphersuite decision 0002 pins.

tests.name: pinned_suite_is_the_one_in_decision_0002

rules.rule: A Welcome or KeyPackage whose credential does not name the device it was claimed for is refused.

tests.name: a_welcome_with_a_foreign_credential_is_refused
a_key_package_must_name_the_device_it_was_claimed_for

rules.rule: Media leaves the device sealed, a tampered blob does not open, and an object is bound to one conversation.

tests.name: a_blob_changed_cut_or_reordered_does_not_open
binds an object to its conversation
refuses a stranger both ways and a used id

rules.rule: A forward never reuses the original media object or key: the file is sealed under a fresh key and uploaded into the target conversation.

tests.name: a_forward_never_reuses_the_original_media_object_or_key

rules.rule: The device store is SQLCipher: not plaintext, and a wrong key does not open it.

tests.name: the_file_is_not_plaintext_sqlite
a_wrong_key_cannot_open_it

rules.rule: A revoked device's token stops working at once and it leaves every group.

tests.name: kills its token at once, deletes its KeyPackages and closes its socket
revoking_a_device_removes_it_from_every_group

rules.rule: Sign-in refuses the wrong PKCE verifier, a reused code and a foreign redirect.

tests.name: refuses the wrong PKCE verifier
refuses a code used twice
refuses a redirect that is not the app's

rules.rule: An identity belongs to one account; linking one another account holds is refused.

tests.name: refuses an identity another account holds
does not take a Google subject for a kennitala that happens to be equal
refuses an ID token that does not verify, and changes nothing

rules.rule: Joining a Google account into the Kenni account moves its device and data, revokes its other devices, and deletes only the account left without an identity.

tests.name: joins a Google account into the Kenni account: the device, its token and Google move
revokes the joined account's other devices
deletes an account left without an identity, and no other

rules.rule: A build below its platform's floor gets 426 before its token is looked at.

tests.name: answers 426 on a /v1 route, before the token is looked at, and leaves /health open
a_build_below_the_floor_is_told_to_update

rules.rule: The server keeps a kennitala only as an HMAC, and a Google subject or address not at all.

tests.name: keeps the kennitala only as an HMAC
keeps neither the subject nor the address, not even in the HMAC's place

rules.rule: A log line carries only allow-listed fields, and redacts anything that could be a name, kennitala or phone number.

tests.name: drops a field that is not on the allow list
redacts a string that is not an opaque id
redacts a run of digits that could be a phone number or a kennitala
carry neither the kennitala nor the name, nor the token

rules.rule: The PII guard finds a person's kennitala by its check digit and an Icelandic phone number.

tests.name: finds a person's kennitala with or without a hyphen, redacted
finds an Icelandic phone number with its country code

rules.rule: Every Durable Object stub is pinned to the EU jurisdiction, through the seam only.

tests.name: refuses a jurisdiction other than the EU
fails when a stub skips the jurisdiction
fails on a bare idFromName, even inside the seam
fails on a jurisdiction other than eu

rules.rule: D1 and every R2 bucket are created in the EU jurisdiction, and no Queue exists.

tests.name: fails on an R2 binding without the EU jurisdiction
fails on a D1 created without --jurisdiction eu
fails on a renamed D1 database, a stray bucket and a queue

rules.rule: The server deletes messages, Welcomes and media 30 days after they were stored.

tests.name: deletes messages and Welcomes 30 days after they were stored, not the GroupInfo
expires objects after 30 days

rules.rule: Messages are numbered in order, a resend gets the first seq, and a lost answer loses and doubles nothing.

tests.name: numbers messages in order and answers a resend with the first seq
a_restart_between_sealing_and_the_answer_loses_and_doubles_nothing

rules.rule: A muted conversation sends no push and shows no notice until its mute ends or is turned off, and a mute is the account's and goes when the account leaves.

tests.name: owes no push for a muted conversation, and drops what it owed
owes a push again once a mute has ended, and deletes the ended mute
is cleared when the account leaves the conversation, or is deleted
a_muted_conversation_shows_no_notice_then_or_after_it_is_unmuted
a_mute_set_while_a_device_was_away_reaches_it_at_sync_and_ends_on_time

rules.rule: Only a member reads or writes a conversation, its roster and its devices.

tests.name: refuses an account that is not a member
answers its roster to members only
answers 403 to an account outside the conversation and 404 to none

rules.rule: A blocked account cannot claim the blocker's KeyPackages or be brought into a conversation, and cannot reach the blocker again.

tests.name: stops the blocked account claiming the blocker's KeyPackages, until lifted
refuses a commit that brings in an account that has blocked its sender
a_blocked_account_cannot_reach_the_blocker_again

rules.rule: Deleting an account revokes every token, leaves the rosters, wipes the inbox and deletes its uploads.

tests.name: revokes every token, leaves the rosters, wipes the inbox and deletes the rows
deletes an account's uploads with the account
keeps a deleted account out of every later claim (0028)

rules.rule: A push goes to the other accounts only, for an urgent message, and carries nothing but a wake-up.

tests.name: pushes a message to the other accounts only, and a commit or an urgent: false to no one
never sends what another round already sent, when two rounds overlap

rules.rule: A message under a disappearing timer is never forwarded, so no copy outlives the timer its conversation agreed to.

tests.name: a_message_under_a_timer_deleted_or_not_a_message_is_not_forwarded

rules.rule: A shared post carries only its id: no copy of its text or its author's name, in the message, the list's last line or a notice, so a deleted or blocked post shows nothing.

tests.name: a_shared_post_carries_only_its_id
a_shared_post_carries_only_its_id_and_shows_what_the_server_holds_now
a_forwarded_share_is_shared_again_by_its_id_and_a_reply_quotes_it
